_help: Manual screen statuses. Key = feature/ScreenName (as shown on the site). Set status to 'finalized' when the team validates a screen (planned, in-dev and developed are computed automatically). 'since' (YYYY-MM-DD) is the finalization date shown on the timeline. Optional 'note'. Optional 'issues': [123, 456] links extra open issues to a screen when their title does not contain the screen name.
